review_comment: This request is cancellable if you give it the parent task id. I don't think that system index migration is cancellable though, right? I assume that's by design since most system indices and data streams are small, so no need to be able to cancel this?

> I don't think that system index migration is cancellable though, right? I assume that's by design since most system indices and data streams are small, so no need to be able to cancel this?

Yes

>This request is cancellable if you give it the parent task id

SystemIndexMigrator uses `ParentTaskAssigningClient`, I believe it should set the parent task id to the requests
